title: Tomy finds a fully funded master's
caption: She just graduated... and found a FULLY FUNDED master's abroad 🎓✈️ MBZUAI (Abu Dhabi) is open to ALL nationalities: free tuition, monthly stipend, flights, visa. Deadline 15 Dec 2026. Comment LINK 👇 #scholarship #fullyfunded #studyabroad #mastersdegree #storytime

scenes.backdrop: sunny university campus lawn on graduation day, red brick buildings, green trees, colorful balloons, blue sky

beats.say: I did it! Bachelor's degree... done!
Okay. Now what? My mum already asked when I'm starting my master's. The ceremony isn't even over!
Congratulations, Tomy! Why do you look so worried on your big day?
beats.text: Congratulations, Tomy! Why do you look so worried on your big day?

beats.say: Hi Kuddus! I just finished my bachelor's degree. Do you know any fully funded master's I can apply for?
beats.text: Hi Quddus! I just finished my bachelor's degree. Do you know any fully funded master's I can apply for?

beats.say: Hi Tomy. I understand you're looking for a master's program abroad?
Yes! Abroad. Far. Very far.
Okay. Are you looking for fully funded, partial funding, or self funded?
Fully funded, please. My bank account just heard this conversation and fainted.

scenes.backdrop: cozy modern coffee shop interior with warm hanging lamps, green plants, big windows, soft afternoon light

beats.say: Then let me show you this. There's an open admission right now at M B Z U AI, in Abu Dhabi, and it's fully funded.
beats.text: Then let me show you this. There's an open admission right now at MBZUAI, in Abu Dhabi, and it's fully funded.

beats.say: M B Z... what? Is that a university or a Wi-Fi password?
beats.text: MBZ... what? Is that a university or a Wi-Fi password?

beats.say: Ha! It's the Mohamed bin Zayed University of Artificial Intelligence. The world's first university focused only on A.I.
beats.text: Ha! It's the Mohamed bin Zayed University of Artificial Intelligence. The world's first university focused only on AI.

beats.say: And when you say fully funded... what does it actually cover?
Free tuition. A monthly stipend. A return flight home every year. Health insurance. And they handle your U.A.E. student visa.
beats.text: Free tuition. A monthly stipend. A return flight home every year. Health insurance. And they handle your UAE student visa.

beats.say: Wait. They pay ME to study? Somebody hold me!
But... am I eligible? I mean, I'm from Nigeria.
Yes, you are. It's open to all nationalities. Your passport is not the problem.
For the master's, you need a bachelor's degree in computer science, maths, or engineering.
Computer science! That's me!
But my cousin studied history. Is there anything for her?

Yes. Commonwealth Shared Scholarships in the U.K. close on December eighth. And the Euroculture Erasmus Mundus master's in Europe pays fourteen hundred euros a month. That deadline is January fifteenth.
beats.text: Yes. Commonwealth Shared Scholarships in the UK close on December 8th. And the Euroculture Erasmus Mundus master's in Europe pays €1,400 a month. That deadline is January 15th.

beats.say: Okay, I'm taking notes. What documents do I need for M B Z U AI?
beats.text: Okay, I'm taking notes. What documents do I need for MBZUAI?

beats.say: Your transcripts, a C.V., and a statement of purpose. Then you apply online on their admissions page. And check the English test rules there too.
beats.text: Your transcripts, a CV, and a statement of purpose. Then you apply online on their admissions page. And check the English test rules there too.

beats.say: And please, don't wait for the last day. The deadline is December fifteenth, five P.M., U.A.E. time.
beats.text: And please, don't wait for the last day. The deadline is December 15th, 5 PM, UAE time.

scenes.backdrop: cozy student bedroom at night, warm fairy lights, bookshelf, posters, window showing city lights

beats.say: Kuddus! Good news! I've already packed my suitcase!
beats.text: Quddus! Good news! I've already packed my suitcase!

beats.say: Tomy... you haven't even applied yet.
Positive energy, Kuddus! Positive energy!
Submit the application first. Then pack.
Fine. Transcripts... C.V.... statement of purpose...
beats.text: Fine. Transcripts... CV... statement of purpose...

beats.say: Submitted! Now I can pack. Again.

scenes.backdrop: night city skyline with soft bokeh lights, purple and teal glow, cinematic

beats.say: Want the link to apply? Comment LINK, and check the link in our bio.
And follow, so you don't miss part two!
